meta.subsidies.html.title: Subsidies for hotels | Lemnion · Hospitality Energy Solutions | EIA · MIA · ISDE · SPRILA
meta.subsidies.html.description: Discover all subsidies for energy solutions in hotels: EIA, MIA/Vamil, ISDE and SPRILA. Lemnion helps with applications and maximises your benefit.
subsidies.intro: The government encourages energy storage and sustainability with substantial subsidies. Lemnion helps your hotel benefit to the full, from application to payout.
subsidies.label: Keep reading
subsidies.h2: Up to 60% subsidy on your investment
subsidies.intro2: The Netherlands has several subsidy schemes specifically aimed at energy investments for businesses. By combining them smartly, your hotel can recoup up to 60% of the investment.
subsidies.eia-p: Additional deduction on taxable profit for energy-saving business assets. Battery storage, EMS and charging infrastructure qualify.
subsidies.mia-p: MIA: up to 36% additional deduction on environmental investments. Vamil: 75% free depreciation, so you set the pace.
subsidies.mia-li2: Vamil: free depreciation on 75% of the investment
subsidies.mia-li3: Combinable with EIA for maximum benefit
subsidies.isde-p: Sustainable Energy Investment Subsidy for commercial users. Specifically for solar panels, heat pumps and solar water heaters.
subsidies.isde-li2: Fixed amount per kWp of installed capacity
subsidies.sprila-label: Subsidy scheme for private charging infrastructure at companies
subsidies.sprila-p: Subsidy scheme for private charging infrastructure at companies: chargers on owned or leased premises for guests and staff. Ideal for hotels.
subsidies.sprila-li1: AC charging station ≥11 kW or DC charging station ≥20 kW
subsidies.sprila-li2: Own or leased premises, also for guests
subsidies.sprila-status: Reference date: 17-08-2026 · Open for applications · Budget €122.5m · Applications until 18-12-2026 · Source: RVO.nl
subsidies.ere-p: Not a subsidy, but an additional revenue stream: Emission Reduction Units (EREs) you earn per delivered kWh of green power to chargers. From 2026 the successor to HBEs. Tradable to fuel suppliers.
subsidies.ere-li2: Earn per kWh of green power to EVs
subsidies.ere-li3: Applies to all charging: staff and guests
subsidies.ere-li4: Tradable: fuel suppliers must surrender them before 1 April
subsidies.ere-status: 26-29 June 2026 · Source: Joulo via Duurzaam Ondernemen
subsidies.ere-tip: 💡 Not automatic: register the chargers through a booking service provider (e.g. ere-registratie.nl or Earnergy) | they arrange the NEa registration, audit and sale. Requirements: MID meter + verifiable green power.
subsidies.spula-label: Public Charging Infrastructure Subsidy, heavy transport
subsidies.spula-p: Subsidy scheme for public charging infrastructure in public spaces, specifically for heavy vehicles (trucks, freight traffic). Usually less relevant for hotels | the hotel scheme is SPRILA.
subsidies.spula-status: Reference date: 17-08-2026 · Open for applications until 18-12-2026 · Source: RVO.nl
subsidies.help-h2: From application to payout, fully managed
subsidies.help-intro: Applying for subsidies is specialist work. Lemnion works with subsidy experts who handle the complete application for your hotel. No hassle with forms, no missed deadlines | we make sure you get what you are entitled to.
subsidies.help-s1p: We analyse your planned investment and determine which schemes apply, including combinations for maximum return.
subsidies.help-s2p: Our experts prepare the complete application and submit it to the right authorities. All you have to do is approve.
subsidies.help-s3p: We monitor the status and ensure the grant decision is converted into an actual payout, down to the last euro.
subsidies.cta-h2: Curious what your hotel could save?
subsidies.cta-p: Run the configurator and find out in 1 minute how much subsidy your hotel could receive.
subsidies.eia-reken1: A hotel invests €120,000 in a battery system.
subsidies.eia-reken3: At 25.8% corporate tax: €12,384 net tax advantage.
subsidies.eia-reken4: Plus regular depreciation on the remaining €72,000.
subsidies.mia-reken1: A hotel invests €180,000 in battery + solar panels.
subsidies.mia-reken4: Net year-1 advantage: ~€28,000 in lower tax burden.
subsidies.isde-reken1: A hotel installs 200 panels (80 kWp) | investment €72,000.
subsidies.sprila-reken1: A hotel installs 4 twin charging posts (8 charge points) | AC from 11 kW.
subsidies.sprila-reken2: Subsidy: ~€800 per twin post × 4 = €3,200 (or DC ≥20 kW: ~€1,950 per station).
subsidies.ere-reken1: A hotel with 4 chargers × 200 kWh/month of green power.
subsidies.ere-reken3: At ~0.5 kg CO₂eq reduction per kWh: ~4,800 EREs per year.
subsidies.ere-reken4: Current market price (June 2026): €0.480 per ERE → ~€2,304 extra per year.
subsidies.ere-reken5: Resale value fluctuates | extra margin on top of the kWh price.
subsidies.spula-reken1: Companies building charging infrastructure in public spaces for heavy vehicles.
subsidies.spula-reken2: Hotels letting guests charge on their own premises: use SPRILA.
